Stephanie — nice drafts. Quick notes inline: 

- One-pager: change line "up to 90% token cost reduction" to "significant cost reductions via caching and quantization" — avoid specific percentages in a public collateral unless we have permission.
- Case study (HyperBank): redact the exact p95 latency numbers; keep relative improvement language ("reduced p95 latency by a factor of X"). We should replace customer-specific throughput figures with ranges unless HyperBank agreed to public numbers.
- Slides: on slide 4 demo script, add a fallback script line if the live demo lags (e.g., switch to recorded demo + highlight cache benefits).

I'll attach a quick redlined version of the case doc in the shared Drive.
